
```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-scASCE
#| tbl-cap: "Site Classification. Source: American Society of Civil Engineers ASCE/SEI 7-22 (2022)"
#| tbl-label: "!expr(sprintf('fig-%s', as.character(as.numeric(Sys.time()))))"

Caption <- "Site Classification. Source: American Society of Civil Engineers ASCE/SEI 7-22 (2022)"

SC=c("A","B","BC","C","CD","D","DE","E","F")
Description=c(
  "Hard rock",#A,>1500 m/s
  "Medium hard rock",#B,910 to 1500 m/s
  "Soft rock",#BC 640 to 910 m/s
  "Very dense soil or hard clay",#C 440 to 640 m/s
  "Dense sand of very stiff clay", #CD 300 to 440 m/s
  "Medium dense sand or stiff clay",#D 210 to 300 m/s
  "Loose sand or medium stiff clay",#DE 150 to 210 m/s
  "Very loose sand or soft clay",#E
  "Soils requiring site response analysis (ASCE/SEI 7-22 21.1)")#F

Vs30=c(
  ">1500 [m/s]",
  ">910-1500 [m/s]",
  ">640-910 [m/s]",
  ">440-640 [m/s]",
  ">300-440 [m/s]",
  ">210-300 [m/s]",
  ">150-210 [m/s]",
  "<=150 [m/s]",
  "*See ASCE 7 section 20.2.1")

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  SC=SC,
  Description=Description,
  Vs30=Vs30)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(library="flextable",font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER)
TBL <- flextable::set_table_properties(TBL,layout = "autofit")

TBL
```
